stories.title: Trump Says He Wants to 'Clean Out' Gaza, Send Refugees to Egypt and Jordan
stories.summary: President Donald Trump proposed moving Palestinians from heavily bombed Gaza to Egypt and Jordan, either temporarily or for the long term. He described the enclave as a demolition site, while Arab countries have rejected such relocation proposals since the war began.

stories.title: Kim Jong Un Is Doing Everything He Can to Keep North Korea's Youth in Line
stories.summary: Kim Jong Un is promoting a ‘shock brigade’ of 300,000 North Korean teenagers and young adults drafted into flood-reconstruction work. The effort is presented as part of his push to discipline the country’s youth and insulate them from Hollywood and K-pop influences.

links.headline: Kim Jong Un Is Doing Everything He Can to Keep North Korea's Youth in Line
